# Mayank Aggarwal — Digital Marketing & AI Specialist

> Professional portfolio, interactive marketing tools, and technical guides of Mayank Aggarwal, based in Delhi, India.

## About
Mayank Aggarwal is a Digital Marketing & AI Specialist with 1 year of hands-on experience in performance marketing, Meta Ads management, generative AI video production (Runway Gen-3, Kling AI), and short-form content strategy. He holds a B.Com (Hons) degree from Shaheed Bhagat Singh College, University of Delhi, and operates under the agency brand Klikwise.

## Core Capabilities & Services
- **Performance Marketing (Meta Ads):** Account structure, Pixel/CAPI setup, Advantage+ campaigns, and creative testing for D2C and service businesses.
- **Social Media Management:** 30-day content calendar execution, reel scripting, and brand authority positioning.
- **AI Video & Filmmaking:** Generative promotional videos and UGC ads using Runway Gen-3 Alpha, Kling AI, and sound design.
- **AI Voiceover & Audio Design:** Neural voice narration using ElevenLabs Multilingual v2 with commercial audio clearance.
- **AI Images & Creative Branding:** Midjourney v6.1 prompt engineering, static ad variations, and graphic design assets.
- **Content & Reel Strategy:** 3-second hook formulas, retention pacing, and short-form video frameworks.
- **SEO & AEO Architecture:** Keyword mapping, on-page schema structuring, and high-intent topical clusters.

## Published Playbooks & Articles (50 Comprehensive Guides)
- [How to Start Meta Ads for a Small Business in India (Step by Step)](https://mayankaggarwal-one.vercel.app/blog/how-to-start-meta-ads-small-business-india): To launch Meta Ads in India effectively, avoid the 'Boost Post' button. Instead, set up Meta Business Suite and Ads Manager, install the Meta Pixel on your website, create a Sales or Leads campaign objective, configure manual placements for Instagram Reels and Stories, and begin with a testing budget of ₹500 to ₹1,000 per day spread across 3 creative variations.
- [Meta Ads Pixel and Conversions API Setup: A Beginner's Checklist](https://mayankaggarwal-one.vercel.app/blog/meta-ads-pixel-conversions-api-setup-checklist): The Meta Pixel alone loses 15% to 30% of conversion data due to iOS privacy constraints, ad blockers, and browser cookie restrictions. To fix this, implement the Meta Conversions API (CAPI) alongside the browser Pixel. This creates a hybrid server-to-browser tracking setup that deduplicates events and restores accurate ROAS attribution.
- [Meta Advantage+ Shopping Campaigns (ASC): Setup Guide for 2026](https://mayankaggarwal-one.vercel.app/blog/meta-advantage-plus-shopping-campaigns-guide): Advantage+ Shopping Campaigns (ASC) use AI automation to consolidate prospecting and retargeting into a single campaign. To make ASC profitable in 2026, set an existing customer budget cap between 10% and 15%, feed at least 15 to 20 diverse creatives (video reels, carousels, customer reviews), and let machine learning distribute spend dynamically.
- [How to Reduce Meta Ads Cost Per Lead (CPL) in India (Proven Tactics)](https://mayankaggarwal-one.vercel.app/blog/how-to-reduce-meta-ads-cpl-india): Reducing Cost Per Lead (CPL) on Meta Ads in India while keeping lead quality high requires three adjustments: switch to Instant Forms with 'Higher Intent' review steps, add 2 custom qualifying multiple-choice questions, and trigger instant WhatsApp confirmation messages within 5 minutes of form submission.
- [Facebook Ad Account Disabled? How to Appeal and Recover in 2026](https://mayankaggarwal-one.vercel.app/blog/facebook-ad-account-disabled-appeal-recovery): When a Meta ad account is restricted, do not panic or immediately create a new account from the same browser. Check Account Quality, identify the flagged policy violation (misleading claims, unverified payment, or page feedback score), and submit a structured appeal through Meta Business Support chat with government ID verification.
- [Meta Custom and Lookalike Audiences: The Complete 2026 Strategy](https://mayankaggarwal-one.vercel.app/blog/meta-ads-custom-audiences-lookalike-strategy): In a privacy-first marketing landscape, first-party custom audiences provide your strongest competitive advantage. Build high-value customer lists segmented by purchase frequency, generate 1% to 3% Lookalikes from top-tier lifetime value (LTV) customers, and create 60-day Instagram engagement retargeting pools.
- [B2B Lead Generation on Meta Ads: How to Get High-Ticket Clients](https://mayankaggarwal-one.vercel.app/blog/b2b-lead-generation-meta-instant-forms): B2B lead generation on Meta Ads succeeds when you treat Facebook and Instagram as executive discovery platforms. Target founders and directors during evening scroll hours, lead with authoritative industry breakdown assets, and qualify prospects using custom fields before scheduling discovery calls.
- [COD vs Prepaid in Indian E-Commerce: How to Optimize Meta Ads](https://mayankaggarwal-one.vercel.app/blog/cod-vs-prepaid-e-commerce-meta-ads-india): Cash on Delivery (COD) drives 60% of Indian e-commerce volume but carries painful 25% to 40% Return-to-Origin (RTO) rates. To improve margins on Meta Ads, test prepaid discounts (₹100 off or 10% instant discount via UPI), require WhatsApp OTP confirmation on COD orders, and optimize ad copy around verified prepaid perks.
- [Meta Ads Creative Fatigue: The 7-Day Testing and Refresh Framework](https://mayankaggarwal-one.vercel.app/blog/meta-ads-creative-fatigue-testing-framework): Creative fatigue occurs when ad frequency rises and click-through rates (CTR) plummet as target audiences tire of seeing the same visual. To maintain stable ROAS, implement a 7-day creative testing sandbox: test 3 new hook angles weekly, promote winning variations to your scaling campaign, and retire decaying ads fast.
- [ROAS vs MER: Which Growth Metric Actually Matters in 2026?](https://mayankaggarwal-one.vercel.app/blog/roas-vs-mer-which-marketing-metric-matters-2026): In-platform ROAS (Return on Ad Spend) is frequently distorted by view-through attribution and platform self-reporting. Marketing Efficiency Ratio (MER = Total Store Revenue / Total Marketing Spend) offers a clean, unvarnished measure of business health and profitability across all acquisition channels.
- [How to Make AI Video Ads with Runway, Kling and Higgsfield (Workflow)](https://mayankaggarwal-one.vercel.app/blog/how-to-make-ai-video-ads-runway-kling-higgsfield): Creating photorealistic AI video ads without costly video shoots requires a hybrid pipeline: generate base character and product plates in Midjourney, animate motion vectors in Kling AI or Runway Gen-3 Alpha, inject camera movement prompts, composite real product packaging in DaVinci Resolve or Premiere, and master with ElevenLabs neural voiceover.
- [Runway Gen-3 Alpha Camera Prompts Cheat Sheet for Commercials](https://mayankaggarwal-one.vercel.app/blog/runway-gen-3-alpha-camera-prompts-cheat-sheet): Runway Gen-3 Alpha responds best to precise cinematic cinematography keywords rather than descriptive prose. Control speed, focal length, and axis vectors using commands like 'slow continuous 360-degree orbit', 'dolly in macro push', 'low-angle pedestal up', and 'whip pan transition'.
- [Kling AI vs Runway Gen-3: Which Tool is Better for Ad Commercials?](https://mayankaggarwal-one.vercel.app/blog/kling-ai-vs-runway-gen-3-commercial-comparison): When choosing between Kling AI and Runway Gen-3 Alpha for commercial ad production: Kling AI is superior for complex human body movements, facial emotions, and liquid pouring physics, while Runway Gen-3 Alpha leads in cinematic architectural lighting, realistic reflections, and fine camera trajectory control.
- [Higgsfield AI for Mobile Video Ads: Fast UGC Video Production](https://mayankaggarwal-one.vercel.app/blog/higgsfield-ai-ugc-video-ads-workflow): Higgsfield AI is built specifically for social-first, mobile video generation. By leveraging mobile framing presets, energetic camera motion, and relatable avatar styles, marketers can produce dozens of native-feeling UGC ad variations for Instagram and TikTok in minutes.
- [Midjourney v6.1 for E-Commerce Photography: 10 Ad Prompt Formulas](https://mayankaggarwal-one.vercel.app/blog/midjourney-v6-ecommerce-product-photography-prompts): Achieve photorealistic e-commerce imagery in Midjourney v6.1 by specifying real physical camera models, lens apertures, specific lighting fixtures (softbox, Rim light, golden hour sunbeam), and tactile material textures like frosted glass, brushed brass, or wet marble.
- [How to Keep Character and Product Consistency in AI Video Ads](https://mayankaggarwal-one.vercel.app/blog/ai-video-consistency-character-and-product-seeds): To prevent characters and products from warping across multi-scene video ads, generate a turn-around character model sheet in Midjourney, lock the random seed number across generations, use image-to-video (I2V) with identical first frames, and composite final brand labels in video post-production.
- [How to Edit and Composite AI Video Clips in DaVinci Resolve](https://mayankaggarwal-one.vercel.app/blog/how-to-composite-ai-video-in-davinci-resolve): Raw AI video generations often suffer from artificial smoothness and plastic textures. In DaVinci Resolve, apply 35mm film grain, speed ramp static moments to 120%-150% for modern social pacing, motion-track real SVG brand logos onto packaging, and color grade with custom LUTs.
- [Commercial Rights and Copyright for AI Ads in India (2026 Rules)](https://mayankaggarwal-one.vercel.app/blog/commercial-rights-and-copyright-ai-advertising-india): Under current Indian legal frameworks (Copyright Act 1957 and ASCI guidelines), purely machine-generated outputs lack independent copyright ownership unless significant human creative direction is demonstrated. To protect brand campaigns, maintain paid commercial platform subscriptions, keep project prompt logs, and disclose altered media per Meta guidelines.
- [ElevenLabs AI Voiceover for Ads: Tips for Natural-Sounding Audio](https://mayankaggarwal-one.vercel.app/blog/elevenlabs-ai-voiceover-ads-natural-audio-tips): To prevent ElevenLabs voiceovers from sounding robotic or monotonous, select expressive narrative models (Eleven Multilingual v2 or Turbo v2.5), set Stability between 35% and 55%, calibrate Similarity to 75%, and use punctuation hacks (em-dashes, ellipses, phonetic spelling) to enforce natural human breathing beats.
- [Best ElevenLabs Voice Settings for Commercial Ads and Reels](https://mayankaggarwal-one.vercel.app/blog/best-elevenlabs-voice-settings-for-commercials): Different commercial genres require radically different ElevenLabs slider calibrations: set Stability at 35% with 15% Style Exaggeration for energetic social media hooks, 55% Stability with low style exaggeration for corporate SaaS explainers, and 45% Stability with deep low-end speaker boost for luxury branding.
- [How to Generate Hindi and Indian English AI Voiceovers in 2026](https://mayankaggarwal-one.vercel.app/blog/how-to-generate-hindi-and-indian-english-ai-voiceovers): Generating authentic Hindi and Indian English AI narration requires using Eleven Multilingual v2, writing scripts in conversational Hinglish or Devanagari script for precise vowel pronunciation, and selecting voice models trained natively on Indian speaker accents rather than foreign accents attempting transliteration.
- [Audio Mastering Chain for Social Media Ads: The 4-Plugin Stack](https://mayankaggarwal-one.vercel.app/blog/audio-mastering-chain-for-social-media-ads): Raw voice tracks exported from AI generators lack acoustic consistency across phone speakers. To master ads professionally, apply high-pass filtering at 85 Hz, tame harsh sibilance with a de-esser around 6.5 kHz, apply a 2.5:1 optical compressor, and normalize to -14 LUFS integrated loudness.
- [Foley Sound Design and Royalty-Free Music Strategy for Reels](https://mayankaggarwal-one.vercel.app/blog/royalty-free-music-and-foley-sound-design-for-reels): Over 70% of video ad emotional impact comes from auditory design. Layer tactile foley sounds (sub-bass drops, camera shutters, paper whooshes) on visual cuts, duck background music by -12 dB whenever speech occurs, and use commercially cleared tracks to prevent ad muting.
- [AI Voice Cloning in Advertising: Legal Regulations in India](https://mayankaggarwal-one.vercel.app/blog/ai-voice-cloning-ethics-and-legal-regulations-india): Under landmark rulings by Indian High Courts (such as the protection of celebrity personality and voice rights under Article 21 and the DPDP Act), cloning real individuals without written commercial consent is illegal. Advertisers must utilize synthetic stock voice personas or obtain written rights agreements.

To hold over 65% retention through the 3-second mark, combine an auditory disruption, a visual pattern interrupt, and an open knowledge loop within the first 45 frames.
